header.note: Checksums at 0x50 and 0x70 MUST be recomputed after any change (header or payload).

payload.note: Compact JSON (no spaces) at plaintext offset 16, zero padded to offset 0xFA010; binary tail (photos?) follows and must be preserved.

confidence_levels.likely: strong evidence, not tested in game
confidence_levels.guessed: name or magnitude only; needs an in-game experiment

fields.name: User ID (save binding)
fields.description: Compared by the loader with the current user ID; equals the Savedata\<digits> folder name. Changing it rebinds the save (header checksum 0x70 recomputed).

fields.name: Payload length
fields.description: Must equal file size - 0x100.

fields.name: Lap (header copy)
fields.description: Header copy of MissionData/lap_num (equal in 42 of 42 saves). Value 1 in all 42 saves, including saves the uploaders call NG+: no evidence this is the NG+ lap counter (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled).

fields.name: Chapter (header copy)
fields.description: Slot-menu display value; keep in sync when progress is edited.

fields.name: Mission progress (header copy)
fields.description: Equal to main_mission_progress in all 12 user saves.

fields.name: Play time (header copy)
fields.description: Equals total_play_time captured 50-235 ms later (header copy newer in 42 of 42 saves). Unit probably microseconds (see player.total_play_time).

fields.name: Save time (Unix, UTC)
fields.description: time() at save; shown in slot menu.

fields.name: Unknown 0x38
fields.description: Observed 0 (7 saves) and 3 (35 saves) (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). Candidate: difficulty index (every save with difficulty_clear_flag_[3] set has 3, every save with flag [0] set has 0); not independent of the uploaders' labels.

fields.name: Unknown 0x3C (location/stage id?)
fields.description: Save-point / room id? 26 distinct values in 30..322 (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). Not a function of progress (the same progress gives different values in 5 of 8 repeated cases).

fields.name: Unknown 0x40 (u64, date-like)
fields.description: Decimal-packed number: 0 in 6 saves, otherwise values like d x 10^12 + k x 10^9 (+ ...); 18 distinct values (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). Computed from game-state components in the writer; meaning unknown.

fields.name: Completion code (header copy)
fields.description: Packed decimal: ones = current_end_, tens = difficulty_clear_flag_[3] (0/1), hundreds = is_new_game_plus_tutorial_compl (0/1). Matches 42 of 42 saves and the exe's a + 10b + 100c arithmetic; only 6 combinations seen (0, 11, 15, 101, 111, 115) (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled).

fields.name: Encrypted flag / nonce byte
fields.description: Loader decrypts only when non-zero; random-looking non-zero byte otherwise. Keep non-zero.

fields.name: Main mission progress
fields.description: Chapter*1000 + checkpoint (e.g. 9030). Also copied to header 0x20/0x24. 25 values seen (observed_values, a non-binding hint); other checkpoints may be invalid. Do not set arbitrary values: invalid checkpoints may break loading.

fields.name: Lap number
fields.description: Value 1 in all 42 saves, including saves the uploaders call NG+ (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). The exe has Get/SetSaveDataLapNum, but there is no evidence yet that this is that counter.

fields.name: Last selected lap
fields.description: Value 1 in all 42 saves, same as lap_num (uncontrolled).

fields.name: Points (senki)
fields.description: Equal to 'sen' in all 42 saves (0..56,525) (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled); likely the shop currency. Set both. Which one the game reads is untested.

fields.name: Points (sen)
fields.description: Mirror of senki (equal in all 42 saves); unclear which one the game displays.

fields.name: Bukun
fields.description: Always 0 in all 42 sample saves: probably unused; editing is untested.

fields.name: Player level
fields.description: Always 1 in all 42 sample saves: probably unused; editing is untested.

fields.name: Skill max level
fields.description: Always 1 in all 42 sample saves: probably unused; editing is untested.

fields.name: Total play time
fields.description: Matches header 0x28. Unit probably microseconds: in two same-session slot pairs play-time gap / wall-clock gap = 0.9995 and 0.9875; maximum seen 66.8 h (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). Experiment 4 still needed.

fields.name: Unlocked amulet slots
fields.description: Observed 1 in 27 saves (all with no clear), 2 in 2, 4 in 13; 3 never seen (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). amulet_slot has 4 entries.

fields.name: Current film slot
fields.description: Observed 0..4 (5 values) (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled); the schema keeps 0..10 until the real maximum is known.

fields.name: Item unique-number counter
fields.description: Counter for new item instances; do not lower it. Grows along one playthrough (Spearman 0.999 with progress in one 21-save set) but is not monotonic across unrelated saves.

fields.name: Endings / clear count
fields.description: Observed 0 (29 saves), 1 (9) and 5 (4); 5 in the 100% and all-unlocked saves (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled). Ones digit of header 0x48. Possibly a clear / ending counter; untested.

fields.name: NG+ tutorial complete
fields.description: True in 6 of 42 saves, always with current_end_ >= 1 (6 of the 13 saves that have one); hundreds digit of header 0x48. Consistent with the key name (NG+ tutorial complete) (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled).

fields.name: Difficulty clear flags
fields.description: 4 flags per save. Only 6 combinations seen in 42 saves: none set, [3] only, [0] only, [2]+[3]; flag [1] never set. Tens digit of header 0x48 equals flag [3]. Order and names unknown (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled).

fields.name: Inventory item count
fields.description: Stack count of an owned item (one row per key per save). LIKELY, not confirmed: a community cheat table (third-party, another game build, uncontrolled) reads the quantity at +8 and the key at +0 of a 16-byte entry, which matches our key, key_num, num, flag order; in the 42 sample saves rows stay at 0 after use and key_num is a per-instance id, not the count. Limits: not checked in our exe or in the game (experiment 2 not run); Prayer Beads reaches 128-420 and 99999, and the unnamed key 0x7A5EBCFF reaches 99999, so per-item caps are unknown (the table's 99 does not hold for them); saves with 99999 may be hand-edited. Observed up to 420 on ordinary rows. Names for keys are in docs/items.json (likely at most).

fields.name: Inventory item id (hash)
fields.description: Hashed item id: 546 distinct keys, all < 2^31, low byte always 0x00 / 0x7F / 0x80 / 0xFF (docs/items_observed.md). Read-only until names are mapped.

fields.name: Item instance id (key_num)
fields.description: Per-instance id: unique per row in each save and <= item_object_unique_number in 42 of 42 saves; for the same key it differs between unrelated saves. NOT the stack count. Informational, read-only (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled).

fields.name: Item row id (entry_number)
fields.description: Per-row id: unique per row in each save and <= item_object_entry_number in 42 of 42 saves. Informational, read-only (42 saves of other players, uncontrolled).

fields.name: Storage item count
fields.description: Same structure assumed; storage_items is empty in all 42 sample saves, so editing is untested.
